Dylan — confirmed. Details below and attaching the artifacts you can share with EuroLedger (redacted SOC 2, bridge-letter template, and a simple hosting topology diagram).

1) SOC 2 Type II report: coverage period 2026-06-01 to 2026-11-30 (testing period for operating effectiveness). The report is finalized and the redacted version is available for customer upload; see attachment Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20261130_redacted.pdf.

2) Hosting / data residency: for UK-paid/provisioned tenants we run the data plane in AWS eu-west-2 (London). That region stores customer content and logs for UK tenants.

- Control plane: our control plane for orchestration and telemetry is hosted in us-east-1. We do not persist customer content in the control plane; only minimal, pseudonymized telemetry and routing metadata are transmitted for operational purposes.
- Cross-border transfers: where telemetry or metadata leaves the UK, it is limited in scope (no customer PII), pseudonymized, and covered by our DPA + standard contractual clauses. We can provide the DPA excerpt and SCCs upon request.

3) Bridge letter: we have a standard bridge-letter template that covers residual assurance for short gaps between audit windows. See attachment Redwood_bridge_letter_template_20261201.docx. It includes the audit dates, the controls in scope, and the authorized signature block for our VP Security.
